name: Forever N Ever
detailed_description:
WHAT IS Forever N Ever?

  • Forever N Ever is a psychological horror-romance visual novel where nothing - and no one - is what they seem. Not even you.

  • Featuring ball-head visuals with a heavy "choices-matter" system, the story plays across multiple timelines. Your decisions matter through the past, present, and future. Mistakes can be corrected… or repeated. If they are still alive.

  • Find who is the mysterious criminal:

    • A mysterious killer stalks the hell. Some say it's a demon. But that can’t be right… because the only demons that you know keep dying, one by one. Is it searching for someone? 

  • Trust system:

    • Trust is a dangerous game. Each choice leads you closer to the truth - or deeper into a lie. Telling the truth might feel right - but would a sweet lie keep things from falling apart? 

  • Sanity system:

    • Stay calm. Don’t listen to the voices — not yours, not theirs.
      Let the fear in, and things will start to spiral: paranoia, instability... violence.

    • keeping your stalker sane might be the only thing standing between you and a much worse fate.

    • Manipulate, abandon or protect your friends.

  • Like system:

    • Just because someone likes you doesn’t mean they’ll trust you. But liking you… well, it heavily influences whether they decide you’re worth saving when the situation calls for it.

  • Persistent choices:

    • Be careful what choices you make, some won’t be forgotten. Not everything is forgotten. You’re trapped in a beautiful, magical realm of hell. Why even am I here, why am I not a devil, like the others?

BRIEF STORY DESCRIBTION

A killer is on the loose - people say it’s a demon. But, who? It seems like they think it might be you...

Your neighbor Matyash has been acting strange - too friendly, too persistent. He wants to walk you home. Saying it’s for your safety. But is that all it is? Since when does he even care...

Meanwhile, your friend Christine is throwing a birthday party. She really wants you to come. But with everything going on, can you risk it? What if something happens? With all the attention on you is it really a good idea?

Michael, your long-lost friend suddenly appears wanting to rewing old good times. Something seems fishy though, what happened between him and his old girlfriend? Is he really someone you should put your trust into?

In Forever N Ever, nothing is simple. Not love. Not friendship. Not even the truth.

Who can you trust - and what will it cost you?

Will the stalker or killer get you first? Or perhaps will it be you who gets them?

content_descriptors.notes:
Thsi game contains themes of psychological horror, stalking, character death, and emotionally intense situations. Some characters consume tobacco and alcohol products.

The game is set in a fictional, folkloric version of the underworld(hell) inspired by Slavic and Czech fairy tales (such as the classic "čert" figures). Though terms like “devil” and “hell” are used, the setting is mythological and symbolic in nature - not religious or satanic.

Player discretion is advised.
